title: Is the fringe part of the green?
question: If your ball comes to rest on the fringe just beside the green, is it treated as being on the putting green according to the rules?

choices.text: Yes, the fringe is part of the green
No, only the green itself counts
Only if any part of your ball touches the green and the fringe at the same time
It depends where your feet are standing

explanation: According to the rules, the fringe is not part of the putting green, even if it is right next to it. Only the area marked as the putting green counts.
